summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly report by a foreign private issuer, presenting financial results including a net loss of CAD 14.67 million, exploration expenses increasing to CAD 9.97 million, cash declining to CAD 22.95 million, and proceeds from warrants exercised. No transaction, strategic event, or special-situation action is described. The document is purely a periodic reporting obligation with no deal terms or corporate action affecting shareholders.
